flows_intro: Rules keep every chat on track. Workflows chain your tools and AI models into repeatable steps. Automations run either on a schedule. New ones start turned off so you can review them first.
flows_workflowsHint: Steps you run on demand or on a schedule.
flows_ruleTagline: Rule · followed on every turn while on
flows_workflowTagline: Workflow · runs when you call it
flows_conceptRule: Standing instructions for the agent, written in plain language or drawn as steps. Add checks to have Sona block a turn that breaks them.
flows_conceptWorkflow: A diagram of steps: use a connected tool, hand work to an AI model, branch on a decision. Run it from any chat.
flows_conceptAutomation: Runs a prompt or a workflow on a timer, with the tools you link to it.
flows_tplWrittenHint: A written rule the agent follows in every chat.
flows_tplWrittenText:
Ask before deleting files or rewriting history.
Run the tests before saying the work is done.
Keep changes small and explain what changed.
flows_tplBranchesHint: Sona blocks turns outside a worktree or off a feature/ branch.
flows_tplTriageHint: Pull issues from one tool, decide, then fix or file a task in another.
flows_tplTriageFetchText: List the issues opened since the last run.
flows_tplTriageDecideText: Yes when the issue reports broken behavior; no for requests and questions.
flows_tplTriageFixText: Find the cause and propose a fix on a new branch.
flows_tplTriageTaskText: Create a task with the issue title, a link to it, and a short summary.
